subject: Mobile Development
title: The iPhone App Store Launch
description: A quick win: understand The iPhone App Store Launch.

hook.text: On July 10, 2008, Apple launched the App Store with just 500 apps.

buildup.text: Users could browse, buy, and install apps in seconds — all from one trusted place.

discovery.text: In the first weekend, users downloaded ten million apps. No one expected that.

twist.text: Steve Jobs initially opposed third-party apps. He wanted web apps only.

climax.text: The App Store proved that a curated marketplace could create an entire economy.

quiz.question: How many apps were in Apple's App Store at launch?
